points: Maintaining a point-of-sale system with 150+ users and 10,000+ daily transactions.
Developing offline, multi-device support so operations continue without connectivity.
Implementing idempotency and atomic header-and-detail transactions for invoices and orders.
Developing an e-commerce backend and REST APIs with .NET.
Building MCP servers and AI chatbots that generate SQL queries from natural language.
Developed an inventory and supplies system with SQL Server.
Optimized query performance by designing and tuning SQL Server indexes.
Built REST APIs with .NET for internal applications.
Implemented role-based users and permissions in internal applications.
Created Angular interfaces for employee management.
